message: 会計監査っておいしいの？

name: Nanaka
message: 「And so, it's time for an accounting audit! I'm gonna crack down hard, ya hear」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Nanaka's actually looking pretty reliable」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave it to me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that look?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, do you even know what an accounting audit actually is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh. Don't underestimate me! An accounting audit is a righteous crusade to expose financial corruption lurking in the academy, help the weak, and crush the strong!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, we are going to defeat corrupt magistrates」

name: Misa
message: 「My head hurts... That's not what I'm asking. I'm asking what the actual, concrete duties involve」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?! Are you picking a fight with a righteous crusade?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where are the corrupt magistrates!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not reliable at all, hey」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you can't blame her. None of us have ever done Student Council work before, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's with that look?\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you so eager to conduct an audit when you don't even know what it entails?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gulp」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, having enthusiasm is a good thing」

name: Misa
message: 「And do you understand it yourself, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just about to have you teach me--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, uh, it's about checking whether each club is using their money properly, right? You barge into the clubroom shouting, 'I challenge this dojo!' and stuff」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The treasurer is quite ignorant」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr! Such a bold, confident declaration?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that situation, the proper line is the classic, 'Echigoya, you are quite the villain yourself'」

name: Ria
message: 「'No, no, after you, Magistrate'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And right while they're talking like that, you throw a kogatana knife. Then, *thunk*, it sticks right into the desk, and--」

name: Ria
message: 「'Who goes there?!'」

name: Misa
message: 「That is NOT how a financial audit works!\s09」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? What's a financial audit? Weren't we talking about crushing the weak and helping the strong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got 'weak' and 'strong' backwards」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, crushing the strong sounds awfully hard」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You obviously can't go around crushing the weak!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not even the main issue! You people don't understand this at ALL!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Scratch that last part! I just got it mixed up with a period drama and things got a liiittle weird」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So anyway, we storm into the clubroom, toss the place, find suspicious goods! Grill 'em, serve 'em a katsudon, get 'em to confess their fraud, and slap on the cuffs! Victory!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We weren't talking about period dramas?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course we weren't!\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「She lived abroad for a long time, so it's only natural she'd have a lot of misconceptions about this country's customs」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, that's right. It was strictly a foreign country and definitely not Heaven or anything. I'll be sure to reread my guidebook later」

name: Ria
message: 「A financial audit isn't nearly that forceful, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! Doesn't the Student Council have the right to do surprise audits and search the clubrooms?! I-I've been tricked!」

name: Ria
message: 「We do search clubrooms sometimes, but only after we've examined the account books, receipts, and bankbooks submitted by each club and found something suspicious」

name: Misa
message: 「Barging in out of nowhere... How utterly uncivilized」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaddaya mean, 'uncivilized'?! I'll have ya know I'm born and bred Edoite through and through!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're born and bred Ryuusei through and through, actually」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop getting sidetracked over every little thing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, something seems fishy here. Why are you so eager to inspect the clubrooms in the first place?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp?」

name: Misa
message: 「You have a guilty conscience, don't you. No, you definitely do. There's no mistake about it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I DO NOT HAVE A GUILTY CONSCIENCE. I AM MERELY BURNING WITH PASSION FOR STUDENT COUNCIL ACTIVITIES」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh. That is some splendid pole reading. Clap, clap」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan. What's 'pole reading'?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd wager she means \{monotone reading|\s12\s12\s12}」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Nobody knows everything at first. It can't be helped. I didn't understand any of it at first either」

name: Misa
message: 「Even you were like that, Onee-sama... In that case, it can't be helped」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「What is it, Synn-kun\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「To conduct an accounting audit, we first need each club to submit their ledgers, receipts, and bankbooks, right」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, that's right\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Acting like the only goody-two-shoes to steal Ria-chan's heart--that's not fair, Mao--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyappu!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Should we go around to them to collect the submissions?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And search their clubrooms while we're at it」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope. First, we ask the Broadcasting Committee to make a school-wide announcement telling everyone to submit their ledgers, receipts, and bankbooks to the Student Council」

name: Misa
message: 「This is the civilized way to do things, Miss Treasurer♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't act all high and mighty just because you happened to know」

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting defensive when you're the one who didn't know looks pretty lame, man」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You bounce back fast, Mr. Panda」

name: Synn
message: 「How far out should we set the submission deadline?」

name: Ria
message: 「Since this is a surprise audit, we can set it for tomorrow's lunch break」

name: Ria
message: 「Clubs that don't submit by the deadline will have their budget allocations suspended next year, so I think everyone will turn theirs in properly. For the most part」

name: Synn
message: 「'For the most part' means... that's pretty strict, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this what they call 'survival of the tastiest'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Fittest'」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, asking why they couldn't submit on time is also an important duty of the Student Council. If they have a valid reason, we have to help them out」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case... since we don't have much time today, we'll wrap up after asking the Broadcasting Committee」

name: Ria
message: 「Right. We'll have them broadcast it once right now, then once during each break tomorrow, and the financial audit will start after school」

name: Misa & Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait--when did you start having such a long conversation with Senpai like the two of you are alone?! You really never let your guard down, do you!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I'd better head straight to the broadcasting room right now. We're short on time, after all」
Well, the broadcasting room is in the same building, so it's right nearby.

name: Ria
message: 「Since it's your first time, there's probably a lot you won't know... Synn-kun, shall the two of us go together?」
Does that mean, just the two of us?

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes! Ba-dump...\s03」

name: Nanaka & Misa
message: 「Aah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before we knew it, Synn and Senpai--」

name: Misa
message: 「Before we knew it, Onee-sama and Sakura-kun--」

name: Nanaka & Misa
message: 「Got so close?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, ooh, I want to go too! I want to know everything~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right! Then let's all go together!」

name: Ria
message: 「Good idea. I think it's best for everyone to learn the duties of every position at least once」

name: Nanaka & Misa
message: 「Phew... Of course nothing like that would happen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't harmonize with me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say it in unison!」
